title: Thai Chicken Stir-Fry
description: A vegetable-heavy stir fry sweetened and heated by a third of a cup of chilli jam. The jam is the whole seasoning, so taste it before you buy: brands run from mild to fierce.

items.note: half goes in with the vegetables, half with the cornflour

items.raw: 1 cup sugar snaps or snow peas
2 teaspoons salt reduced chicken-style stock powder (Massel)

steps.text: Cut the chicken into bite sized pieces.
Coat a non-stick frying pan or wok with cooking spray and saute the garlic, ginger and chicken for 3 minutes.
Add half a cup of the water with the carrots, broccoli and onion, and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the sugar snaps and silverbeet and cook for 3 minutes, or until the vegetables are done to your liking.
Add the chilli jam, lemongrass, soy sauce and stock powder.
Combine the cornflour with the remaining water, add it to the pan and stir continuously until the sauce has boiled and thickened.

notes: The source offers lean rump steak, butterfly pork steak, lean lamb leg steaks or 400 g tofu in place of the chicken, all diced.
Chilli jam brands vary enormously in heat and sugar. Taste yours before committing a third of a cup.
Sodium is around 546 mg a serve even with the reduced salt soy and stock powder, because the chilli jam carries salt too.

nutrition.assumptions: Read off the printed panel, chicken column, which gives every field. Serving size of 355 g is worked out from the ingredient masses, roughly 1.58 kg reducing about 10% over four servings, and excludes any rice or noodles; the per-100 g column is derived from that.
